correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the full proof with N>=t>=5, m>=3: a longest multipartite path uses min(|S|,2(|S|-a)+1) vertices, yielding the published majority-part face cover. Each C_i is a cone, all cells above degree d=t-2 belong to one cone, and at degree d the C_i skeleton supports are disjoint. The LES of (K,sk_d simplex) maps their top-cycle kernels injectively into the top simplex-skeleton cycle group; their direct sum is a saturated sublattice of the ambient free d-chain group, so homology is free only in degree d. Skeletal connectivity, van Kampen and Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead produce a wedge of R spheres, including R=0. Truncated Euler/binomial identities give R; orientation sign of a g-fixed simplex equals (-1)^(vertices-cycles), so the signed fixed-face polynomial, with Hopf trace, gives chi_t. This establishes the theorem for all parameters; independent finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: A natural and timely topology problem for forbidden-path vertex-subset complexes of complete multipartite graphs, with all numbers of parts and threshold parameters, not an arbitrary small instance. The result determines the entire nonequivariant homotopy type and integral top homology, proves torsion-freeness, and supplies an explicit rational character for every within-part permutation (not merely ranks at identity). It fills a substantive topological/refinement gap relative to the previously published combinatorial decomposition and bipartite homotopy theorem; the classification and representations are plausible reusable invariants.
